svg.title: Seed knowledge graph
svg.desc: Seed knowledge graph with 23 topics and 20 relations, grouped by connected component: Object-oriented, Graphs and trees, Algorithms, and Arrays and hashing. Circles advance right or down by prerequisite depth. Solid arrows mean required before; dashed arrows mean has subtype. Motion follows Variables to Objects to Classes to Abstract Classes to Interfaces to Design Patterns, then Pointers to Linked Lists to Trees to Binary Search Trees to AVL Trees.
